Engineering exercise 001: Close sub-resolution scan fissures.
Read XYZ surface samples in millimetres as a documented union-of-splats envelope. Close fissures on the 0.4 mm scale without claiming to reconstruct an unseen solid interior. Show the correct Offset order and measure the actual volume change.
Use PicoGK 2.3.0, .NET 9, and an explicit headless 0.2 mm Library. Input contract: unoriented XYZ in mm; do not invent an inside/outside sign. Build direction is +Z; plate is z=0; default evacuation gravity is -Z unless the exercise specifies another removal pose. Nominal minimum wall is 1.0 mm, a coupon design assumption awaiting process calibration.
Provide a complete commented C# program with input and output arguments. Preserve review-only candidate.stl, report strict >45-degree underside failures, wall-ray samples, mesh edge incidence, material components, layer islands and powder-void connectivity. Do not label geometric screens as physical, leak-tight, fatigue or manufacturing qualification.
